# Quality Rubric
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

Score each applicable area from 0 to 5. A score of 4 or 5 is required for a strong result. A critical security or access failure blocks acceptance regardless of score.

| Area | 0 | 3 | 5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Scope traceability | No mapping | Main changes mapped | Every change mapped to a requirement or approved operational need |
| Functional correctness | Does not run | Core path works with gaps | Required path works with objective evidence |
| Access security | Private access absent | Basic gate exists | Routes, APIs, files, revocation, and direct requests are tested |
| Code quality | Unmaintainable or unsafe | Understandable with issues | Clear, focused, validated, and consistent with selected stack |
| Test quality | No tests or evidence | Partial checks | Automated and manual checks cover the changed behavior |
| Operations | No deployment or recovery plan | Staging works | Versioned deployment, backup, restore, monitoring, and rollback are documented as applicable |
| Handoff clarity | No usable handoff | Some paths or gaps listed | Another person can review, test, and continue without guessing |

Record the score, reason, evidence, and blocking issue for each area. Do not hide missing evidence inside a numeric score.
